banner.title: gha-runner-scale-set
banner.tagline: Keeps a warm self-hosted runner for each repo and grows to fifteen when jobs queue.

art.about: self-hosted GitHub Actions runners that scale on a queue of jobs
art.title: From a queued job to an ephemeral runner pod

explainer.title: From a queued job to a single-use runner pod

steps.title: Listen
steps.text: A listener pod long-polls GitHub for jobs on the home-ops and ai-k8s-sandbox repos.
steps.scene: a listening antenna over a glowing job queue

steps.title: Scale
steps.text: The controller creates one single-use runner pod per job, between 1 and 15 pods per scale set.
steps.scene: stacked cyan pods rising from a dial

steps.title: Register
steps.text: Each runner registers with GitHub using skrumbach-runner-secret, synced from the 1Password item github.
steps.scene: a key sliding into a runner badge

steps.title: Run
steps.text: The job runs in the runner container. The home-ops set adds a talosctl binary; the sandbox set adds a privileged Docker sidecar.
steps.scene: a terminal window with a neon prompt inside a pod frame

steps.title: Clean up
steps.text: The pod exits after one job. Its work volume goes with it: an emptyDir on home-ops, a 20 GiB Ceph block claim on the sandbox set.
